name: subject-exam-workbench
description: 学科备考工作台——具有来源约束与多智能体互动课堂的 Electron 桌面学习系统

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/learning/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/collab-service/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm typecheck:ipc
scripts.lint: eslint apps/learning/app apps/learning/components apps/learning/lib apps/collab-service/src apps/desktop/src packages scripts/quality scripts/format.mjs scripts/check-code-quality.mjs scripts/check-public-boundaries.mjs
scripts.check:code: node scripts/check-code-quality.mjs && node scripts/check-public-boundaries.mjs && node --test scripts/freshness-check.mjs scripts/quality/source-files.test.mjs scripts/quality/source-boundaries.test.mjs scripts/quality/eslint.test.mjs scripts/quality/ipc-contract.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm check:code && pnpm test
